name: Palmeraie de Tioute
hero_subtitle: Palm oasis and village south of Taroudant — greenery after the ochre walls.

overview.title: Green contrast to the walled town
overview.p1: Tioute offers palms, irrigation and a slower village pace a short drive from Taroudant. It is the classic nature counterpoint after a morning on the ramparts and souks.
overview.p2: Visits are often arranged with a driver. Respect private gardens and ask before photographing people.

moods.title: Tioute through the day
moods.subtitle: Shade under palms makes this more forgiving than open plateau walks.

1.title: Fresh start
1.desc: Best temperatures for walking the oasis paths.

2.title: Deep shade
2.desc: Stay under the canopy when the sun is high.

3.title: Warm return light
3.desc: Nice for photos before driving back to Taroudant.

food.title: Eat around Tioute
food.p1: Simple village options or a pre-arranged lunch may be available. Otherwise plan main meals in Taroudant.
food.p2: Tioute is about landscape more than restaurants.

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: Private taxi or organised trip from Taroudant (roughly 30–45 minutes depending on stops).

2.title: Respect
2.desc: Stay on paths; ask before photos of people.

3.title: Combine
3.desc: Works as a half-day after walls and souks, or a quieter alternative afternoon.

q2.question: Need a 4x4?
q2.answer: Not for the main access; some tracks may be rougher.

q3.question: Good for children?
q3.answer: Yes at an easy pace in the shade.

q4.question: Same day as the ramparts?
q4.answer: Yes — walls in the morning, Tioute in the afternoon is a popular split.

q5.question: Guide useful?
q5.answer: Helpful for paths and local context, not mandatory.
